title: Reverse Linked List
statement:
Given the `head` of a singly linked list, reverse the list, and return the reversed list.

Since this judge represents lists as plain value arrays, build a real `ListNode` chain from `values` first, reverse it using the standard three-pointer technique (`prev`, `curr`, `next`), then convert the reversed chain back to an array to return.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is in the range [0, 5000]

editorial.approach: Build the list from the array, then walk it with three pointers: `prev` (starts null), `curr` (starts at head), and a temporary `next`. At each step, save `curr.next`, then point `curr.next` back to `prev`, then advance `prev` and `curr` forward. When `curr` becomes null, `prev` is the new head. Convert it back to an array to return.
